title: Make main's first honest CI run pass: Kani flag, racing observation test, vacuous acceptances
goal: The first completed main run (37430509046) exposed what cancellations and the dead runner hid: (1) Kani now gets a runner but fails at once because --concrete-playback needs -Z concrete-playback on 0.68, and its binary cache buys nothing (cargo install kani-verifier takes 2.6 s); (2) audit_retention_prune_observation_cost_measured_and_attributed races on process-global SUSI_OBSERVATION_FILE/SUSI_AGENT under libtest (llvm-cov), reproduced with a constant 24-byte foreign record; (3) T-DEEPSEEK-87/118/119 accept with a package-less cargo nextest that matches no tests in the root package (exit 4), so they never verified anything.
